name: @arena/payments-adapters
description: Deterministic DEMO payment-provider adapter (Work Order C010; issue #77; architecture-lock rule 33: expert payment, Arena fees, settlement and payout stay behind the provider-neutral PaymentProviderPort from @arena/payments). No real provider integration: the demo adapter executes clearly-labelled demo transfers (the truth-label law — demo money is never customer money), idempotently and deterministically on the instruction key, with an append-only in-memory transfer log as the reference fabric. Merchant-of-record, payout/settlement rails, tax and jurisdiction responsibilities remain explicit OPEN production questions (PROVIDER_POSTURE_OPEN_QUESTIONS), recorded — never guessed. Adapters never import services (boundary rule B4).
